reply_text:
I found one weak candidate for 2022 and no AGI or long-range AI timeline predictions from Nadella that year.

**The one candidate.** In his Build keynote on 24 May 2022, Nadella said Microsoft would make GitHub Copilot generally available "later this summer." It qualifies only narrowly: it is a near-term product launch announcement rather than a forecast about what AI will be able to do. I read the words in Microsoft's official keynote transcript (PDF). I don't count the same keynote's "Project Volterra will be available later this year", because that is a hardware developer kit.

**What else I checked:**
- **Annual shareholder letter (24 Oct 2022).** The AI passage looks forward but has no date. It says large AI models are becoming "platforms themselves". Its only dated targets are about skills and land conservation, not AI.
- **Adam Grant's ReThinking podcast (24 May 2022).** I read the full transcript and found nothing dated about AI.
- **Ignite 2022 keynote (12 Oct 2022).** The page I opened only links to a transcript PDF, and I had no page openings left to read it. That keynote is still unchecked.
- **Stratechery interview with Nadella and Mark Zuckerberg (12 Oct 2022).** It is about the metaverse partnership. I didn't open it.

**Two problems on my side:**
- A coding error lost the first text I fetched from the Build PDF and the Ignite page, so I opened both a second time. Six openings were used in total, but only four distinct pages.
- I ran 9 of the 12 searches.

The three fixed searches returned only coverage from 2023–2026.
